Assembly notes

Before putting the wooden frame together, check every joint and mark the reference edges with a pencil. When the pieces are the same length, the joints meet cleanly on both sides and the frame stays square. Check the diagonals a second time before tightening the clamps.

See the reference manual for measurements.

  • Measure the diagonals.
  • Label the joints.
